info.title: Loop Cards API
info.description: Complete stored content. Collection cursors bind owner, database and normalized selection. This general document describes authenticated requests. Trusted single-user standalone installations may additionally accept requests inside their configured access boundary; that deployment exception is not a global anonymous security alternative. See cards-api.md for synchronization, scope and deployment semantics.

CardBearer.description: Read routes only. results:read permits Results; cards:read permits Results, Saved and Sent. Never send tokens in URLs.

OwnerSession.name: Cookie
OwnerSession.description: Complete Cookie header from the authenticated Loop owner session, including cookie names. Preserve the deployment's names and values (HTTPS uses the __Secure- prefix). Browsers attach their cookie jar automatically; non-browser clients supply the complete header value.

PairedDevice.name: Cookie
PairedDevice.description: Complete Cookie header from the paired device session, including cookie names. Preserve the deployment's names and values (__Host-loop on HTTPS, loop_local on local HTTP, with an installation suffix for isolated previews). Browsers attach their cookie jar automatically; non-browser clients supply the complete header value. Management writes also require PairedCsrf.

PairedCsrf.name: x-loop-csrf
PairedCsrf.description: Required together with PairedDevice for management writes. Read the csrf value from the authenticated /session response. Also send the matching workspace Origin header.
